product_one_liner.value: Typeface is an AI marketing orchestration platform that helps enterprise marketing teams create personalized, on-brand content and coordinate campaigns across people, agents, and systems.
product_one_liner.notes: The official homepage identifies enterprise marketing teams as the audience and describes coordinating people, agents, and systems for on-brand campaigns; the company page describes the governed marketing orchestration platform.

pricing_page.notes: The official homepage navigation and footer contain no pricing link and direct buyers to demos or sales. The pricing review reports that /pricing returns 404. Together these satisfy the specified false condition.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The official homepage features customer testimonials attributed to ASICS and J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management, rather than merely identifying them as investors or partners. | named_customers.0: ASICS appears in a customer testimonial on Typeface's homepage. | named_customers.1: A homepage testimonial is attributed to the Global Chief Marketing Officer of J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management.

employee_band.notes: The company record reports 304 employees, matching LinkedIn's 304 associated employees and placing Typeface in 201-500. Confidence is reduced because another profile reports 186 and LinkedIn-associated profiles are not necessarily an exact payroll count.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company-maintained LinkedIn profile identifies the primary address in Palo Alto, consistent with its headquarters label. Confidence is reduced because some third-party company records instead use San Francisco. | hq_country: The company profile identifies its primary location as Palo Alto, California, US.

founded_year.notes: Typeface's LinkedIn company profile explicitly states that it was founded in 2022.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index presents product and marketing content, including the orchestration-engine announcement, but does not establish two qualifying engineering-authored implementation posts. The engineering author's index also exposes no qualifying articles. This supports false under the specified threshold, with some uncertainty about index completeness.

public_docs.notes: Typeface has a public developer portal containing an introduction, quickstart, API documentation, guides and recipes, satisfying the requirement for more than a single FAQ.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Senior ML Engineer posting explicitly involves building machine-learning models and systems, meeting the qualifying role-title requirement.

model_provider.value: OpenAI GPT-4; Google Vertex AI, Gemini, Imagen 3 and Veo; Microsoft Azure AI; Stability.ai Stable Diffusion.
model_provider.notes: Typeface's platform page names OpenAI GPT-4, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Azure AI and Stability.ai Stable Diffusion. Its Google partnership page additionally names Gemini, Imagen 3 and Veo.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The official security page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification. Its additional ISO/IEC 42001 certification is outside the requested five categories. | compliance_certs.0: The official security page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II certification. | compliance_certs.1: The official security page explicitly claims ISO 27001 certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Sources disagree between an unattributed VC round, Series C, and Series B+ for the latest reported financing. Without a reliable announcement resolving the stage, null is preferable to guessing. | funding_date: PitchBook and CB Insights identify September 2025, whereas other funding listings claim October 2025. The most recent round's month remains unresolved, so the field is null rather than treating one conflicting listing as definitive. | funding_amount_usd: The latest-round amount could not be reliably established. CB Insights lists a September 2025 round with a masked amount, while Indexed.vc claims a later $100 million October 2025 round. No authoritative announcement resolving this conflict was found; null avoids substituting an older round's amount.

raised_18mo.notes: PitchBook and CB Insights report financing in September 2025, and a dated secondary report claims an October 2025 financing. Although the latest round's exact details conflict, these reported dates fall within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. Confidence is medium because a primary announcement or filing was not located.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Enterprise Account Executive posting describes owning the enterprise sales cycle through negotiation and closing, satisfying the account-executive hiring criterion.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 22, 2026 announcement introduces the next generation of the orchestration engine through Arc Graph, Arc Fabric and Arc Loop. This is a major product launch within six months of November 9, 2026, not a bug fix or UI tweak.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The official company page does not provide a complete dated leadership roster. The identifiable CMO appointment announcement was published June 10, 2025, outside the requested 12-month window. No qualifying in-window change or sufficiently complete roster supporting false was verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The official Salesforce Marketing Cloud integration page describes using Typeface inside Salesforce Content Builder. This is an integration-stack signal, not proof that Typeface uses Salesforce as its own internal CRM. | crm_stack_signal.0: The Salesforce Marketing Cloud integration page explicitly describes Salesforce Content Builder usage with Typeface.
